title: Umbrella-GovOps Evidence Bundle Manifest
description: An EvidenceBundle compiles automated check results and embeds the Beacon receipts that back them. The bundle is signed via DSSE / cosign sign-blob; verifiers MUST re-verify each embedded receipt independently of the outer DSSE signature.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA the bundle was generated from. Optional but recommended.

ucid.description: Optional UCID this check evidences. Used by `umbrella-conformance verify --beacon-bundle` to enforce coverage.

evidence_refs.description: Receipt ids (from receipts[].id) that back this check result. Empty array is permitted only when the check inherently has no runtime evidence (e.g. schema-valid).

receipts.description: Embedded Beacon receipts (verbatim, signed) referenced by checks[].evidence_refs[]. Each receipt is one Beacon-signed JSON object. Verifiers MUST re-verify each receipt with `beacon-verify`.

id.description: Receipt id (matches checks[].evidence_refs[] entries). For foundation receipts this is the entry's entry_sha256; for runtime receipts it is the receipt's id field.

format.description: Beacon receipt format: 'foundation' = chained audit-log entry; 'runtime' = single-shot OVERT receipt.

payload.description: The verbatim Beacon receipt JSON, exactly as signed. Verifiers MUST NOT mutate before running `beacon-verify`.

issued_at.description: Receipt issuance timestamp for freshness checks.
